answer.reason: The verses tell of his illness, his enquiry of Baalzebub and his death as foretold by Elijah, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub, god of Ekron, whether he would recover from his fall
clauses.quote: Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease

clauses.english: died as the LORD had said by Elijah
clauses.quote: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken

doubts: His ship venture with Jehoshaphat (1KI 22:49, 2CH 20:35-37) was left out as a minor detail; the verses also differ on whose ships were broken.
